intro.en: Equipment wire carries power, control, safety and sensor circuits inside machines and industrial control panels.
intro.zh: 设备用电线在机器与工业控制柜内部承担动力、控制、安全和传感回路。

knowledge.en: MTW, AWM and field-installed wiring have different product and installation scopes; exact marking, location and governing standard must be reviewed.
knowledge.zh: MTW、AWM 与现场敷设电线具有不同产品和安装范围，必须审核准确印字、位置与适用标准。

notes.en: Provide the market, machine standard, circuit list, route map, exact wire designation, terminal system and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供目标市场、机器标准、回路表、路径图、准确线材型号、端接系统与验证方案。

delivery.en: Release records the wire identity, construction, cut and strip details, termination combination, routing, traceability and agreed checks.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含线材身份、结构、裁线剥线、端接组合、布线路径、追溯与约定检查。

subtitle.en: Specify the electrical path from panel entry to machine endpoint
subtitle.zh: 从控制柜入口到机器端点定义完整电气路径

lead.en: Coordinate MTW, AWM, conductor, insulation, routing, terminals and machine-level evidence.
lead.zh: 协同审核 MTW、AWM、导体、绝缘、布线、端接与整机证据。
